notes: Private non-profit. 6 faculties: FAME, FICT, FASS, FMCA, Education, Health/Safety/Security/Environment. Also has Graduate School, Institute of International Education, Institute of Ageing. DKU040(B). LCCI RTC, Cisco Networking Academy. Founded 1997, university college 2017. MAPCU affiliated. 42 programs verified from official website with MQA codes.

fees.notes: NEUC publishes a single fee schedule with no local/international distinction: foundation RM11,700 total; diplomas RM23,200-RM38,000 total; bachelors RM39,700-RM48,500 total; masters RM12,200-RM18,200; PhD RM18,200-RM19,200 (official Tuition Fees page https://www.newera.edu.my/enrolment.php?id=142, checked 2026-09-18).
